tools.name: get_api_access_instructions
tools.description: Explain how to get programmatic access to Theta EdgeCloud: how API keys are created, the x-api-key header, the API base URL and where the documentation lives. Use before helping a user call the API.

tools.name: list_gpu_rates
tools.description: List the GPU types Theta EdgeCloud currently advertises with their hourly price in USD per GPU hour, availability and basic specs. Use when a user asks what a GPU costs on Theta EdgeCloud or which GPUs are available.

tools.name: list_on_demand_models
tools.description: List the AI models available through Theta EdgeCloud on-demand inference APIs with their lowest advertised price. Use when a user asks which models Theta EdgeCloud serves or what inference costs.

tools.name: navigate_to_page
tools.description: Navigate this browser tab to one of Theta EdgeCloud's public pages, for example the sign-up form or the RTX GPU pricing page.
